full_name: Gidon Eshel | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Physical Sciences Hrdy Fellow Bard College
bio: Gidon Eshel is a research professor of environmental physics at Bard College. He is best known for his work quantifying the geophysical consequences of agriculture and diet.
